text_block_list.text:
One day, Токай Тэйо and Mejiro
McQueen are
summoned to the student
council office.
Hello.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
What's the important thing you've gotta
tell me,
Prez?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Apologies for summoning you both here
out of
the blue. There is something I'd
like to ask of you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Ooh, what is it?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I'd like you both to be poster models for
the URA.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Oooh! Modeling for a poster?! Woohoo!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
That would be an honor indeed. I gladly
accept
the request.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But why am I being paired up with
McQueen?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Because I recommended her. Do you
have an
issue with that?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You personally recommended her, Prez?
Then I
guess that's fine.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I'm also a little curious as to why Teio
and I have
been selected...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask? Hmm. I could tell you,
but...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This seems like a golden opportunity. I
have an
additional request for you two.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Use your time to think about why the
other was
chosen.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: What?! You want me to figure out why you picked her? Not even why you picked me?!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
You're overthinking it. Just approach it
as a
simple challenge I've set out for
you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Aww, it's not simple at all! How am I
supposed to
know why she chose you?!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Besides, we're only having to rack our brains about this 'cause you insisted on asking!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I merely inquired as to the reason. I
believe the
real issue is your willingness
to accept whatever
the president says
without a second thought!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It's not like I blindly accepted the
request... Well,
anyway. We both agreed
to this, so we'll just have
to do the work.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't we make things
interesting?
Let's turn this into a
competition!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
A competition? And how exactly will we
decide
the winner?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
We give our answers to Prez and
whoever has the
right answer is the
winner. How's that?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Interesting... Very well, then. But if we
really are
going to compete, I will show
you no mercy. Is
that clear?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Bring it on! Okay, ready... GO!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: What?! Why are you running in the same direction I am?! Do not hinder my case!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
My plan is to ask everyone in the
classroom!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: What?! That was my idea! Don't you copy me!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: I am not copying you! And could you please desist with that terrible habit you have of blaming others?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The two of them push and shove each
other as
they race down the hallway.
